Description

The silver-plumed chocobo has a tougher plume compared to most other chocobos and shoots lightning out of its beak. The silver chocobo can be found in desert mountains or near dunes.

Defense

AC 18, touch 13; flat-footed 14 (+3 dex, +5 natural, +1 dodge, -1 size)

hp 80 [112] (7d10+42)

Fort +11, Ref +8, Will +5

Offense

Speed 75 ft., Climb 25 ft., Swim 45 ft.

Melee Bite +11 (1d8+5), 2 Talons +11 (1d6+5)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Choco Thunder

Statistics

Str 20, Dex 16, Con 22, Int 8, Wis 16, Cha 12

Base Atk +7; CMB +13; CMD 27

Feats Dodge, Endurance, Fleet, Run

Skills Acrobatics +17, Climb +19, Perception +10, Survival +4, Swim +17

SQ Choco Cure, Choco Guard, acrobatics, climbing, cloudwalking, sandwalking, surefooted stride, tame

description.value: Silver chocobos are natural at acrobatics. It gains a +8 bonus on Acrobatics checks. It can also take 10 on Acrobatics checks, even if stress or distractions would otherwise prevent it from doing so.

Silver chocobos are natural climbers. It has a climb speed of 20 feet and gains a +8 bonus on Climb checks. It can also take 10 on Climb checks, even if stress or distractions would otherwise prevent it from doing so. Also, it is never flat-footed while climbing.
Silver chocobos can tread on clouds or fog as though on solid ground.
Silver chocobos travel at full speed across sand, rocky ground, or dust, and leaves no trail behind unless it chooses to.

Silver chocobos may move through any sort of difficult terrain (such as thorns, overgrown areas, rubble and the like) at its normal speed without taking damage or suffering any other impairment. Areas that have been magically manipulated, however, still effect it.
Chocobos are relatively tame and docile for magical beasts, and are treated as animals for the purpose of Handle Animal checks.
Protect and Shell affect one recipient. Only on saves against magic.
Recipient only on failure of the corresponding save.
